name: Do I need to replace all my deck boards if only a few are damaged?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to replace all my deck boards if only a few are damaged?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you typically don't need to replace all deck boards if only a few are damaged. We can often perform spot repairs by replacing individual damaged boards. However, if a significant number of boards show similar wear or if the damage is widespread, replacing all of them might be a more cost-effective and aesthetically consistent long-term solution. We will assess the extent of the damage and recommend the best approach for your deck.
acceptedAnswer.description: Not necessarily; individual boards can be replaced, but widespread damage may warrant a full replacement.
